subject: Post-call: PayTrail budget friction, pilot sizing & batching/caching levers
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@paytrail.com>, Elena Morales <elena.morales@paytrail.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 14 Jun 2028 09:17:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call: PayTrail budget friction, pilot sizing & batching/caching levers

Hi Samir / Elena — thanks again for taking time today. Quick recap and the concrete next steps we discussed so everyone is aligned.

Key pain points you shared
- Token spend volatility: spikes during peak hours are pushing you above the monthly budget cap.
- Latency-sensitive user flows (refund chat + instant reconciliation) where tail latency > 800ms impacts UX.
- Procurement window: finance needs a clear pilot ROI to approve a paid pilot (30–60 day decision).

Goals we agreed on
1) Demonstrate a ~25–35% reduction in per-token spend (or equivalent unit cost) for chat/reconciliation flows within a pilot.
2) Keep 95th percentile latency <= 300ms for the critical flows during pilot.
3) Give your procurement team a defensible TCO example for month-over-month budgeting.

Redwood levers we proposed (high level)
- Batching + dynamic batch sizing: expect 10–25% token cost reduction depending on QPS and request size.
- Prefix/KV caching for repeated prompts (refund flows): can yield 15–30% effective token savings on cached prefixes.
- Model selection & quantization: cheaper model variant for non-user-facing summarization tasks.
- Smart routing: route low-latency critical traffic to dedicated capacity and overflow to lower-cost variants for background jobs.

Preliminary TCO anchors (ballpark)
- Pilot A (no dedicated): 20–30% cost reduction, target latency unchanged, low infra commitment.
- Pilot B (reserved capacity + caching): 30–40% reduction with tighter latency SLAs; requires monthly commit.
(Attached: redwood_tco_estimate_v1.pdf with a worked example using your sample QPS)

Immediate asks / next steps
1) You to confirm target pilot start window (you mentioned late June).
2) Please share a 48–72 hour sample of request logs or a CSV of typical request sizes and QPS by hour (we can use the attached paytrail_sample_qps.csv template).
3) Ben will draft two pilot packages with concrete TCO math and an ops checklist.
4) If procurement wants a cost table for DocuSign, Lauren will prepare a short one-page TCO for finance.

Happy to jump on a quick follow-up with procurement if that shortens approvals — schedule options below.

Available times for a 30m technical kickoff next week:
- Tue 6/19 10:00–11:30 PT
- Wed 6/20 13:00–15:00 PT
- Thu 6/21 08:30–10:00 PT

Thanks —
Priyom Das
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
(priyom.das@redwood.com)

(attachment: redwood_tco_estimate_v1.pdf)

From: Samir Patel <samir.patel@paytrail.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Cc: Elena Morales <elena.morales@paytrail.com>
Date: Fri, 15 Jun 2028 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: PayTrail budget friction, pilot sizing & batching/caching levers

Priyom — appreciate the clear summary. Couple quick clarifications: we need a pilot that our finance team can justify in writing. Concrete points: 
- Target: 30% reduction in monthly token costs for the customer-facing chat flows (that’s the number procurement asked for).
- Procurement timeline: they want the pilot scope + a one-page TCO by Wednesday 6/21 so legal can review pricing before the end of the month.
- Budget constraint: cap of $40k for the first 30 days unless the pilot shows immediate >30% savings, in which case we can expand.

I’ll ask ops to export the last 7 days of requests and share the CSV in the same format you requested.

Can you confirm whether Pilot A includes any caching by default or if that’s exclusively part of Pilot B? We really want to try to avoid a large upfront commit unless it’s needed to hit the latency targets.

—Samir
Samir Patel
Head of Platform Engineering | PayTrail
samir.patel@paytrail.com

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@paytrail.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 15 Jun 2028 12:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: PayTrail budget friction, pilot sizing & batching/caching levers

Samir — quick answers and two concrete pilot options below.

Short answer: Pilot A can include prefix caching for a scoped set of intents (no reserved commit). Caching is applied as a software layer and enabled during the pilot; it doesn’t require reserved capacity, but hit rates and latency improvements may be more limited compared to a dedicated pool.

Recommended pilot packages (ballpark numbers, we’ll refine once we see your logs):
- Pilot A — Low-commit scope
  * Duration: 30 days
  * Scope: customer chat + reconciliation endpoints only (subset of traffic)
  * Expected cost delta: ~20–28% reduction in per-token spend using batching + prefix caching (sample-dependent)
  * Commitment: none; usage-billed.

- Pilot B — Reserved + ops SLA
  * Duration: 30 days
  * Scope: all critical flows + background summarization
  * Expected cost delta: ~30–40% after enabling caching, tailored batching, and model routing.
  * Commitment: 1-month reserved capacity (monthly invoice) to guarantee tail latency and priority routing.

What we need from PayTrail for an accurate TCO:
1) 7-day request CSV (hourly QPS, median tokens, 95th tokens, endpoint) — use attached template.
2) Example of 3 representative payloads for the chat flow (we only need anonymized text).
3) Confirmation which endpoints are critical for 95th percentile latency (refund-chat, reconcile-api).

If you can get those over by EOD Monday 6/18 we’ll have a refined TCO + pilot SOW by Tuesday 6/20 and a one-page finance summary for Wednesday 6/21.

I’ll stand up the initial config and run an internal sim in parallel once we have the CSV.

Thanks —
Ben Carter
Solutions Engineering | Redwood Inference
(attachment: pilot_package_quickview.xlsx)

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Post-call: PayTrail budget friction, pilot sizing & batching/caching levers

Samir / Elena — thanks for the update and for confirming the procurement constraints. Quick confirmation and proposed schedule: 

1) Pilot scope: we’ll start with Pilot A (no-reserve) but enable prefix caching for the scoped intents you identified. If we don’t hit the 30% reduction target in the first 14 days, we’ll propose a short conversion path to Pilot B (1-month reserve) with an updated ROI table.

2) Deliverables and dates
- Mon 6/18 EOD: PayTrail provides 7-day CSV + 3 anonymized payloads (you mentioned ops will export this).
- Tue 6/19: Redwood internal sims + preliminary TCO (draft).
- Tue 6/20: 30m technical kickoff (Ben + infra) — we propose 10:30 PT.
- Wed 6/21 EOD: One-page TCO for procurement (Lauren will deliver).

3) Action items assigned
- Samir: share CSV + confirm critical endpoints (reply to this thread).
- Elena: procurement contact for DocuSign and PO process (cc if OK).
- Ben: draft Pilot A config + expected metrics to track (token burn, cache hit rate, p95 latency).
- Lauren: 1-page finance summary template for procurement.

I’ll also create the HubSpot record and share the draft SOW + DocuSign link once Ben’s pilot config lands — placeholders below.
- HubSpot: https://hubspot.example/record/HS-PT-8742
- Draft SOW (internal): https://drive.example/redwood/paytrail/sow-draft

If that plan works, Samir — confirm and I’ll lock the 6/19 10:30 PT slot.

Thanks again — looking forward to moving quickly.
